title: Debezium's Oracle connector doesn't capture Oracle 23's BOOLEAN
versions: Oracle 23 and later (26ai Free 23.26 here); Debezium 3.7.0.Final
symptom: No events for the 8 TPC-DI tables with a BOOLEAN column; tables without one streamed; no error in bronze or Databricks
cause: The Debezium Oracle connector doesn't support the native BOOLEAN type Oracle 23 added (its documentation's Supported data types)
effect: Silent: those tables never change in bronze or silver while the rest stream
fix: Use NUMBER(1) (0/1) with Debezium's NumberOneToBooleanConverter, or SMALLINT; check a schema for BOOLEAN columns before capturing. The test maps booleans to SMALLINT 0/1 on Oracle
notes: Lakeflow Connect's Oracle connector: not tested for BOOLEAN
